application: Relay: lancer_relais_pc_v2 + installer_relais_pc_v3 (approvals in %LOCALAPPDATA%\ClaudeRelais). Skill sync-cloud-pc: relay section to be added with this rule.
controle: Static test of the installer (approval before the task); review of every new launcher or scheduled task.
regle: A mechanism that delivers files to the PC must not be able to make new code run there without an explicit action by the user. An automatic update of a script run by a scheduled task goes through an approval list (name + SHA-256 checksum) kept out of the channel's reach; an unapproved or modified version does not run, the previous one continues and the wait is reported.
source: Design of the GitHub relay (2026-10-16): the first stable launcher (lancer_relais_pc_v1) ran the highest version of relais_pc_vN.ps1 in its folder, a folder that the relay itself can fill; removed from the delivery before installation.
titre: A backup channel never runs received code without the user's approval
